test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Which of the following is not true about EEPROM?

options.text: Electrically erasable programmable read only memory

solution:
Random Access Memory can be classified as

a. read-write memory

b. read-only memory

EEPROM is an electrically erasable programmable read-only memory.

It is non-volatile memory means its data will be retained even when the power is turned off.
